objective: Theory spec of LO F_2 and the O(alpha_s) longitudinal structure function F_L in theory:dis-parton-model (synthetic-only profile)

model.description: LO quark-parton-model F_2 (photon exchange) and the O(alpha_s) longitudinal structure function from the LO coefficient functions, in the Altarelli-Martinelli form: F_L(x, Q^2) = (alpha_s(Q^2)/(4 pi)) x^2 int_x^1 dz/z^3 [ 4 C_F F_2(z) + 8 sum_q e_q^2 (1 - x/z) z g(z) ], C_F = 4/3; F_2(z) = z sum_q e_q^2 (q(z) + qbar(z))

assumptions: photon exchange only; massless quarks, n_f effectively massless flavours (zero-mass scheme)
leading twist: power corrections and target-mass corrections O(M^2/Q^2) dropped (PDG Eq. 18.21)
x^-1 F_L = C_L,ns (x) q_ns + <e^2> (C_L,q (x) q_s + C_L,g (x) g) with the O(alpha_s) coefficients of Moch, Vermaseren and Vogt (c_ns = 4 C_F x, c_ps = 0, c_g = 8 n_f x (1 - x)), mu_R = mu_F = Q
q_ns = sum (e_i^2 - <e^2>)(q_i + qbar_i): the non-singlet combination that reproduces LO F_2 (identified by this profile; the paper does not write it out)
parton densities and alpha_s are inputs; in this profile they are SYNTHETIC toys, not evolved in Q^2

conventions.unit_system: natural-HEP: Q^2 in GeV^2; x, F_2, F_L and alpha_s are dimensionless
conventions.metric_signature: not-applicable (no amplitude is computed; Q^2 = -q^2 > 0 as in PDG Sec. 18.1)
conventions.coupling_normalization: alpha_s = g_s^2/(4 pi); coefficient functions expanded in a_s = alpha_s/(4 pi), C_L,a = sum_n a_s^n c_L,a^(n) [dispm:C04]
conventions.renormalization_scheme: MS-bar as stated by Moch, Vermaseren and Vogt; the O(alpha_s) F_L coefficient functions used here are scheme independent [dispm:C04]
conventions.scales: mu_R = mu_F = Q [dispm:C04]; alpha_s(Q^2) is an input per Q^2 point (toy values in the benchmark, not run)
conventions.energy_variable: Bjorken x = Q^2/(2 M nu) and Q^2 = -q^2 (PDG Sec. 18.1)
conventions.mass_approximation: massless quarks (n_f effectively massless flavours); target mass neglected (O(M^2/Q^2) dropped, PDG Eq. 18.21)
conventions.target_normalization: per nucleon: structure functions of one nucleon; the toy densities describe one invented nucleon
conventions.exchanged_bosons: photon only (F_2^gamma of PDG Eq. 18.18); no Z or W exchange
conventions.em_coupling: not-applicable (F_2 and F_L are defined without alpha; no cross section is computed)
conventions.structure_function_signs: not-applicable (no xF_3 term for photon exchange)
conventions.heavy_quark_scheme: zero-mass: all n_f flavours massless (toy n_f = 4); no heavy-quark mass effects
conventions.factorization_scheme: MS-bar [dispm:C04]; at O(alpha_s) the F_L result does not depend on it
conventions.dispm:observable: F_2(x, Q^2) at O(alpha_s^0) = x sum_q e_q^2 (q + qbar) [dispm:C01]; F_L(x, Q^2) at O(alpha_s^1) = F_2 - 2 x F_1, in the Altarelli-Martinelli form derived in derivations/derivation-record.md
conventions.dispm:parton_densities: number densities q(x), qbar(x), g(x) (not momentum densities x f); convolution C (x) f = int_x^1 dy/y C(y) f(x/y) [dispm:C02]; in this profile they are SYNTHETIC Beta-form toys

extension.order: F_L at O(alpha_s^1) (its leading order, absolute order alpha_s^1); F_2 at O(alpha_s^0)

validity_domain.kinematics: Q^2 >> M^2 (leading twist), W^2 well above the resonance region; x not so small that small-x resummation matters, not so large that target-mass and higher-twist terms do (no numerical bound is derived here)
validity_domain.order: F_L at its leading order only: NLO and NNLO coefficient functions (Moch, Vermaseren and Vogt Eqs. 4-10) are not included
validity_domain.inputs: synthetic toy densities and toy alpha_s values; the numbers say nothing about a real nucleon

checks_run.name: change of variables z = x/y in int_x^1 dy/y C(y) f(x/y) gives int_x^1 dz/z C(x/z) f(z) (SymPy, generic C and f; manual substitution and Integral.transform)
flavour algebra: q_ns + <e^2> q_s = sum e^2 (q + qbar), q_ns flavour-traceless, n_f = 3..6; <e^2> = 5/18 for n_f = 4, 6 (SymPy)
coefficient-function route equals the Altarelli-Martinelli integrand identically (SymPy, generic F_2 and g)
known limit: F_L linear in alpha_s, F_L = 0 at alpha_s = 0 (SymPy and numerical)
positivity: integrand non-negative on x <= z <= 1 for non-negative densities, so F_L >= 0 (SymPy); F_L >= 0 on every toy point
F_L <= F_2 on every toy point (numerical; a property of the toy, not proven in general)
adaptive quadrature against the exact SymPy closed form, 6 x points on SYNTHETIC Beta-form densities
convergence study: Gauss-Legendre rule in ln z with 4..128 nodes converges to the closed form (error at 128 nodes below tolerance; stored in derivations/derivation.json)
convolution route in the original variable y (no change of variables) equals the Altarelli-Martinelli form numerically
units: x, Q^2-independent toy densities, F_2, F_L and alpha_s dimensionless

checks_not_run: comparison with any published F_L value or table (none was read; the profile is synthetic-only)
comparison with measured F_L or F_2
NLO/NNLO coefficient functions, DGLAP evolution of the densities, heavy-quark mass effects, target-mass and higher-twist corrections
formal proof of the factorization formula (cited, not derived)

references_read.citation: E.C. Aschenauer, R.S. Thorne and R. Yoshida, 'Structure Functions', in F. Takahashi et al. (Particle Data Group), Int. J. Mod. Phys. A 41, 2630011 (2026)
S. Moch, J.A.M. Vermaseren and A. Vogt, 'The Longitudinal Structure Function at the Third Order', arXiv:hep-ph/0411112v2, Phys. Lett. B 606 (2005) 123
references_read.location: Eqs. (1)-(3) and surrounding text (printed pp. 1-2); <e^k> definition below Eq. (11) (p. 3)

neglected: Q^2 evolution of the toy densities
